title: ASUS ROG Strix G16 16" RTX 5050 i5-13450HX 2x8GB RAM 512GB SSD 1920x1200 IPS @ 165hz $1,799 Delivered @ Scorptec
body:
Deal: ASUS ROG Strix G16 16" RTX 5050 i5-13450HX 2x8GB RAM 512GB SSD 1920x1200 IPS @ 165hz $1,799 Delivered @ Scorptec

[MrZ] $1800 for a budget laptop - wow. These specs are pretty poor for the price. Is the RAM upgradable - how many slots?
[panda1010101] 2 slots for ram, 2 slots for NVME SSD. Problem is 2 RAM slots are already occupied
[Kumo1887] yup, it's actually a pretty good deal considering it's an Asus Rog series. Should expect laptop with these specs to rise to $2500 in coming months.
[dosada] I'd probably add $200 and go for this
https://www.centrecom.com.au/gigabyte-aero-x16-16-wqxga-ryze…
[panda1010101] The Aero has a 5060 but TGP is 75-85W, and a faster processor. Gaming Performance should be similar on both laptops
[bchliu] Like I was saying to Jarrod - according to his own testing, the 5060 @ 85W is still 10% better than the 5050 at 115W (which is what the Asus is apparently maxed on).
https://youtu.be/txesdgP0Rns?t=83
BTW - maximum for the RTX5050 is 115W TGP - not 140W what OP stated. Most of the performance plateaus at 100W.
[bchliu] Or you can go see Gerry to get the Acer Nitro V 16S for $1698
https://www.harveynorman.com.au/acer-nitro-v-16s-16-inch-cor…
[MrZ] Specs say it has 1x16GB stick. Isn't that much worse for performance than having 2 sticks of 8GB?
